text:
alex: Heads-up — bulk-embeds sample app is getting bursts of 429s from hosted API when we ramp concurrency during onboarding demos.

alex: Repro steps: run `node bulk-embeds.js --concurrency 40 --batchSize 8` against a sandbox key. After ~30s we see ~30% 429s, SDK retries (default backoff) cause long tails.

priya: That sounds like client-side throttle + batching mismatch. Which SDK/version?

alex: Node js-sdk v2.1.3. We use the SDK's auto-batching + a naive semaphore that allows up to 40 in-flight requests.

sam: Can you paste the retry/config snippet? default is exp backoff with jitter and 3 retries right?

alex: config snippet:
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  maxRetries: 3,
  retryDelayMs: 200,
  maxConcurrency: 40,
  autoBatch: true
});
```
No explicit client-side smoothing or windowing.

jen: Two things to call out: 1) high concurrency + batching increases tokens/sec per request and can overflow a key-level QPS; 2) retries amplify bursts (retry storm). Token-bucket or leaky-bucket client-side smoothing helps a lot.

priya: We added "adaptive windowing" in the runtime docs but SDKs aren't exposing a friendly API. The sample app should show `requestWindowMs` + `maxWindowConcurrency` examples.

alex: Also seeing an auth refresh edge: when the refresh trigger occurs mid-burst some in-flight calls 401 then SDK retries from scratch — causing duplicates. Logs show:
```
401 refreshing token
retrying id=1234
429 too_many_requests after retry
```

sam: That's a bug — we should queue requests during refresh and resume, not retry immediately. Can someone file an ENG ticket?

jen: For embeddings we can add `dedupeOnRetry: true` in the SDK which uses idempotency keys when available. That reduces duplicate work when retries happen.

devops-bot: deploy: sampleapp/bulk-embeds v1.2.5 deployed to staging — 1789994400

alex: I pushed a quick patch to the sampleapp adding a token-bucket wrapper around the client (refill 100 tokens / 1000ms) — gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/bulk-client-window. In staging that cut 429s at concurrency=40 from ~30% to ~2%.

priya: Nice! Can we upstream that as `createRateLimiter({capacity, refillMs})` in the js-sdk and add a simple wrapper in python/go SDKs?

sam: +1 but add tests: simulate server SLO (e.g., 100 qps per API key) and assert the client respects it under bursty load. We should include a load-test harness in the sampleapp.

jen: Also update quickstart: recommend `concurrency = Math.min(16, cpu * 4)` and include an example windowing config. Call out token refresh semantics (queue vs retry).

alex: I'll open PRs: devex/sample-apps (add rate limiter example + load test) and js-sdk (expose createRateLimiter + dedupeOnRetry flag). I'll also add a failing unit test that demonstrates 401->retry duplication so the SDK fix is test-covered.

alex: TL;DR: sample-app was recommending naive concurrency; action items: expose client-side smoothing primitives in SDK, fix auth refresh queueing, add dedupeOnRetry for embeddings, and update quickstart docs. cc @priya @jen :thumbsup:
